reviews.title: Simple, yet sophisticated
reviews.text: I have been looking for a prompted journal for quite a long time, but most of the ones that I have found recently have been AI, and I am not too keen on AI knowing my deepest thoughts and feelings. If I am journaling, I want to be talking to myself, and not a robot thank you. And I feel like this app really brings that balance of feeling like guiding you so you don’t come to the blank paper unsure of what to write, but also gives you the feeling of being alone with your own thoughts and feelings, which is so key for journaling. I am really excited for the aspect of being able to come to the same prompts within a few months, and then be able to see your previous answers and being able to see how you have grown and changed throughout the time that you have been journaling. Just a very well thought out app, and I am very excited to support them!

reviews.title: Awesome Content and Context!!
reviews.text: I really like journaling for my own personal satisfaction, and the questions are amazing! I decided to start a mother - daughter journal, and I use many of the same questions with my amazing daughter! After we have completed our questions we can go back read each others answers, and we learn more about one another, but we learn much more about ourselves too! I love the dive deeper subtext because it gives me other insight into the topics! The questions have substance and are interesting and really useful/helpful!! Great App!!
